sources.quote: Cracks at fastener holes found on machined brackets made from EN AW-6061-T6 (alloy group 6xxx).
Root cause not confirmed. A material-related contribution has not been excluded.
Effectiveness verification not yet completed. Report status: OPEN.
BOM-LINE 110: part BR-180 (drawing Rev F); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6061-T6; features: 4 fastener holes

findings.why: Meccanica C has an OPEN 8D on cracks at fastener holes in EN AW-6061-T6, the same alloy as BR-180, which also has 4 fastener holes. A material contribution is not excluded and verification is not complete. The 2026-11-05 email lifts the probation but says the 8D stays open. The proposed move of 40% of BR-180 volume to Meccanica C therefore has an open quality issue on the material. Supplier standing is no longer a blocker, because the probation was revoked on 2026-11-05. The source approval AP-0207 for BR-180 at TO1 for STL is current, so there is no source-release finding.
